changelog: First hub release. Writes a NEW, complete, spec-compliant paper from a requirement (word count / citation style / sections) and/or topic. Two integrity invariants: never fabricate citations, never plagiarize — unverifiable sources are marked [SOURCE NEEDED], not invented. Pre-registered disjunctive stop conditions; independent blind-judge rubric with unknown-exit auditing.
summary: Author a NEW, complete, spec-compliant paper (essay/thesis chapter/literature review/课程论文) from a requirement (word-count/citation-style/sections) and/or a topic-选题. Use for "write me a paper on…", "写一篇…的学术论文", "turn a brief into a paper". NOT to proofread/summarize/humanize/fact-check an EXISTING paper (→ siblings).
